rootCauseAnalysis.issue: Tauri IPC not available in browser testing context
rootCauseAnalysis.description: The proxy management features (add/edit/delete proxies) require Tauri's invoke() IPC mechanism which only works in the Tauri desktop WebView, not when accessing the app via web browser at localhost:1420. The use-settings.ts functions call Tauri invoke without try-catch fallback for web dev mode.
rootCauseAnalysis.suggestedFix: Either (a) add try-catch fallback in use-settings.ts proxy functions to use localStorage in dev mode, or (b) use Tauri's WebDriver testing framework for proper desktop app testing
